speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; to help me narrow down the cause, how long has this pain been present, and does the pain get worse when you cough or sneeze?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation.

Based on your sudden sharp pain while exercising that radiates to your foot, this is highly suggestive of a slipped disc. I am not asking any more questions; I am ready to proceed with your treatment plan or order imaging if necessary.
